name: Lechcamping Spirkenhof
beschreibung: The Lechcamping Spirkenhof campsite is located in the Ehenbichl district of the market town of Reutte, directly on the banks of the Lech. The site is surrounded by the Lechtaler Alpen and the Allgäuer Alpen. The campsite itself is set in a quiet, natural environment and offers spacious pitches on terraces and grassy areas. The facilities include sanitary facilities, a restaurant, and a shop for daily necessities. In addition to pitches, rental accommodations such as chalets and mobile homes are also offered. In winter, the nearby Hahnenkamm ski area can be reached on foot or by ski bus. In summer, the marked hiking and cycling trails of the Naturpark Lechtal are directly accessible from the campsite.
